headline: Executive order names the Board of Peace as a public international organization that can receive certain legal privileges and immunities in the US.
what_it_does: This order designates the Board of Peace as a public international organization under US law. Based on the title, that status lets the organization receive certain privileges, exemptions, and immunities, such as protection from some lawsuits or taxes. No summary was provided, so the exact privileges granted and any limits on them are not clear from the source.

who_it_affects.group: The Board of Peace and its staff
who_it_affects.how: The organization and possibly its officials may receive legal protections and exemptions in the United States that ordinary groups do not have.

who_it_affects.group: People or businesses with legal claims against the Board of Peace
who_it_affects.how: They may find it harder to sue the organization or enforce certain claims in US courts.
